document_metadata.title: 1、EXT. UNIONTOWN - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: The town and its inhabitants, including musicians and pedestrians, are decaying and dead; voices suggest they were once human but now mimic life in a rotting imitation of their former selves.

entities.name: Power outage leaves entire town in darkness
entities.description: The entire town experiences a complete power failure, with no street lamps, building lights, or neon signs functioning, creating an eerie, dark atmosphere.

entities.name: Musicians fail to play instruments properly at gazebo
entities.description: Three musicians in Uniontown Park attempt to play a trombone, saxophone, and tambourine, but are unable to produce coherent music, indicating a malfunction or disturbance affecting their instruments.

entities.name: Tambourine player produces erratic rhythmic noise
entities.description: The tambourine player continues to create a disjointed, unrhythmic series of sounds—'TCHICK! KA-TCHICK-TCHICK'—that persist as the only audible musical output from the group.

entities.name: Gathering In Uniontown Park
entities.description: A group of pedestrians congregate in Uniontown Park around a gazebo where musicians are attempting to perform, forming an informal public assembly centered on a failed musical performance.

entities.name: Closer inspection reveals musicians and pedestrians are dead with rotting flesh
entities.description: Upon closer look, it becomes evident that the musicians and pedestrians in Uniontown Park are reanimated corpses, their flesh decaying, revealing a horrifying transformation beneath the town's perfect facade.

entities.name: Mike and Riley observe that the creatures are imitations of themselves
entities.description: From off-screen, Mike and Riley voice the realization that the undead figures are attempting to mimic the living, and that they themselves were once in the same state.

entities.name: Town's illusion of perfection collapses as decay becomes visible
entities.description: The quaint, idealized appearance of the town dissolves as rot and decay become apparent, exposing a grim reality underlying its previously pristine surface.

entities.name: Mike
entities.description: A character who observes and comments on the creatures imitating him and the decayed state of the town from off-screen.
entities.summary: A character observes and comments on the decaying town and zombie threats alongside Riley, participates in combat, admits inexperience with weapons, and recognizes the massacre unfolding on Main Street as part of a guerrilla group exiting the war wagon Dead Reckoning with Charlie.

entities.name: Riley Denbo
entities.description: A character who observes and comments on the creatures that were once them, indicating a past connection to the town and its inhabitants.
entities.summary: A character with ties to the town observes threats alongside Mike, questions his skills, and identifies Charlie Houk while recognizing walker behavior and making eye contact with Big Daddy.

document_metadata.title: 3、EXT. "UNIONTOWN TEXACO" - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: A deceased teenage couple wanders a derelict Texaco station where a mutilated, undead attendant, once called 'Big Daddy,' mechanically performs his duties despite no cars being present.

document_metadata.title: 11、EXT. DEAD RECKONING - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Riley, Charlie, and Mike prepare to raid a town in the Dead Reckoning with Cholo and guerrillas. Cholo excitedly leaves on a motorcycle, revealing it's his last day. Riley emphasizes completing the job safely. Mike questions the 'sky flowers,' which Riley confirms work by distracting Stenches.

entities.name: Cholo enters dark apartment foyer hearing mysterious squeaking sound
entities.description: Cholo cautiously enters a dimly lit apartment foyer, with the only illumination coming from another room, while a soft, rhythmic squeaking sound echoes through the space, creating an unsettling atmosphere.

entities.name: Cholo discovers hanging body of middle-aged man in kitchen
entities.description: As Cholo moves through the apartment, he turns a corner and sees a middle-aged man hanging lifelessly from a homemade noose tied to a light fixture in the kitchen, the body swaying slightly with a toppled chair at his feet.

entities.name: Cholo is grabbed from behind by hysterical middle-aged woman

entities.description: The hysterical woman asks Cholo if he is security, and upon learning he is not, demands to know who he is while continuing to scream in distress.

entities.name: Young man attempts to cut down hanged man's body using a chair and knife
entities.description: Unseen by Cholo and the woman, a dazed young man enters the kitchen, rights the fallen chair, steps onto it, and begins using a paring knife to cut through the noose supporting the hanging man's body.

entities.name: Hanged man's eyes open and body begins to twitch
entities.description: While the young man is cutting the rope, the supposedly dead man's eyes suddenly open and blink several times, and his body begins to twitch, indicating signs of life or unnatural movement.

entities.name: Hanged man turns and attacks young man
entities.description: After showing signs of movement, the hanged man fully turns and makes a physical move toward the young man who is attempting to cut him down, suggesting a violent or supernatural confrontation.

document_metadata.title: 40、INT. CENTER RING - "THE ARENA" - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Riley finds Slack wounded but alive; they share a moment before police arrive, and Riley is arrested after reporting Chihuahua's death.

entities.name: Riley and Charlie enter the betting room with painted walkers
entities.description: Riley and Charlie arrive in a crowded room filled with bettors surrounding an iron-mesh cage where painted walkers are being prepared for a confrontation.

entities.name: Painted Walkers are released into the iron-mesh cage
entities.description: The gates of the cage open and the Painted Walkers, known as Dead Red and Dead Black, are pushed inside, their nooses removed and the cage locked behind them.

entities.name: Dead Red and Dead Black test each other's paint
entities.description: Dead Red touches Dead Black's face, sees black on its fingers, then Dead Black does the same, tasting the red substance and spitting it out in disgust.

entities.name: Bookies collect bets from spectators
entities.description: Bookies move through the crowd of bettors, taking wagers in cash as the audience anticipates the upcoming fight between the two painted walkers.

entities.name: New gate opens in the cage revealing a live woman
entities.description: A second gate in the cage opens, revealing a living woman—formerly a sex worker known as Slack—who enters the cage to the stunned silence of the crowd and the walkers.

entities.name: Slack is trapped in the cage and surrounded by the Dead Men
entities.description: After the gate slams shut, Slack backs into the cage wall and begins circling as the Dead Men approach and flank her on all sides.

entities.name: Slack punches Dead Black in self-defense
entities.description: Faced with imminent danger, Slack shifts from terror to resolve and strikes Dead Black three times in the face, causing it to recoil and allowing her to escape its grasp.

entities.name: Cage Fight Betting Event
entities.description: A structured, illicit gathering where spectators and bookies assemble to observe and wager on violent confrontations between reanimated beings and live victims inside a caged arena.
entities.summary: A structured, illicit gathering where spectators and bookies assemble to observe and wager on violent confrontations between reanimated beings and live victims inside a caged arena.

entities.name: iron-mesh structure
entities.description: A cage-like enclosure resembling a lion-tamer's cage, surrounded by viewing stands and used to contain the painted walkers and the live woman.

entities.name: last night

entities.name: Riley Denbo

entities.summary: A character with ties to the town observes threats alongside Mike, questions his skills, and identifies Charlie Houk while recognizing walker behavior and making eye contact with Big Daddy.

entities.name: Charlie Houk

entities.summary: A guerrilla group member questions 'flowers in the graveyard,' showing naivety and cunning; another corrects Mike on shooting, while companions with Riley discuss alcohol, pass through security, enter an alley, and reflect on fate amid revolutionaries.

entities.name: Dead Red

entities.summary: A painted walker in the cage fight who reacts to the appearance of Dead Black's paint and participates in the confrontation with the live woman.

entities.name: Dead Black

entities.summary: A painted walker in the cage fight who tests Dead Red's paint and is the first to make physical contact with the live woman, later being punched by her.

entities.name: Slack
entities.description: A woman formerly known as a hooker who is now trapped in the cage with the painted walkers and defends herself against them.
entities.summary: A former sex worker turned prisoner defends herself in a cage, while a wounded inmate reveals alliances and aids Riley's escape; soldiers prepare for battle amid zombie breaches and sarcasm, exposing tensions within Fiddler's Green.

entities.name: Tout
entities.description: An off-screen character who provides information about the betting event to Riley and Charlie, hinting at the novelty of the live woman being used as bait.

entities.name: Riley and Charlie confront Bruisers to retrieve their weapons
entities.description: Riley and Charlie approach the Bruisers who are holding their guns, demanding their return, and the Bruisers begin to hand over the weapons.

entities.name: Slack kicks Dead Black into Dead Red during cage fight
entities.description: As Dead Black reaches for Slack again, Slack delivers a powerful kick that sends Dead Black flying into Dead Red's arms, escalating the physical confrontation between the two painted walkers.

entities.name: Dead Red and Dead Black engage in physical struggle over Slack
entities.description: After Dead Black clings to Dead Red's shirt, the two painted walkers stagger and spin in a violent, chaotic struggle, resembling a grotesque wrestling match, as both attempt to reach Slack.

entities.name: Slack attempts to escape by climbing the cage wall
entities.description: Taking advantage of the chaos, Slack moves to the edge of the cage and begins climbing the iron-mesh structure in an attempt to escape the ongoing confrontation.

entities.name: Dead Red slams Dead Black against the cage mesh
entities.description: Dead Red forcefully throws Dead Black into the iron-mesh wall of the cage, causing the structure to shake violently and disrupting Slack's escape attempt.

entities.name: Riley and Charlie push through crowd toward center ring
entities.description: After retrieving their weapons, Riley and Charlie make their way back through the arena, pushing through the gathered spectators in an effort to reach the central cage.

entities.name: Goon confronts Riley and Charlie about firearms
entities.description: A goon blocks Riley and Charlie's path, enforcing a rule prohibiting guns in the arena, leading to a brief physical confrontation.

entities.name: Riley strikes goon with rifle butt and continues forward
entities.description: In response to the goon's interference, Riley attacks him with the butt of his rifle, incapacitating him momentarily and proceeding toward the ring.

entities.name: Dead Black grabs Slack's ankle and pulls her down
entities.description: As Slack climbs the cage and nears escape, Dead Black seizes her ankle, yanking her back down and slamming her to the ground, resuming the attack.

entities.name: Riley shoots Dead Black to save Slack
entities.description: Just as Dead Black prepares to bite Slack, Riley fires a short burst from his M-16, shattering Dead Black's skull and causing it to collapse.

entities.name: Dead Red lunges at Slack and is shot by Riley
entities.description: Immediately after Dead Black's death, Dead Red attacks Slack, but Riley responds with another burst of gunfire, killing Dead Red as well.

entities.name: Crowd panics and stampedes toward exit after gunfire
entities.description: The sudden gunshots trigger mass fear among the spectators, causing them to rush chaotically toward the arena's exits in a stampede.

entities.description: Amid the chaos, additional gunfire erupts from a Glock pistol, fired by an unknown individual, further escalating the violence in the space.

entities.name: Chihuahua fires at Riley before being blocked

document_metadata.title: 62、EXT. DEPOT - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Riley's team confronts zombies in the subway, with Charlie killing one using a moonlight-aided shot. More threats emerge, prompting Pillsbury to rally the group while Riley calls for backup.

entities.name: Steel doors to the subway tunnel open
entities.description: The heavy steel doors leading into the subway tunnel slide open, allowing access to the devastated depot beyond.

entities.name: Riley and his team emerge into the devastated depot
entities.description: Riley and his team step out of the subway tunnel and enter the ruined depot, encountering destruction, fires, and poor visibility due to smoke.

entities.name: Team observes ongoing fires and downed fences
entities.description: The team surveys the depot and notes active fires, collapsed fencing, and signs of violent intrusion, indicating a recent breach.

entities.name: Tony Baloney is seen waving eerily amidst destruction
entities.description: Tony Baloney is the only figure moving in the depot, waving in a strange and unsettling manner, drawing attention from the team.

entities.name: Charlie comments on the extent of the damage
entities.description: Charlie remarks that Cholo could not have caused all the destruction they are seeing, suggesting a larger force was responsible.

entities.name: Riley disputes Charlie's assumption about the cause of destruction
entities.description: Riley asserts that Cholo did not cause the widespread damage, pointing instead to signs of a larger, external attack.

entities.name: Thick black smoke from fires restricts visibility in the depot
entities.description: Dense clouds of black smoke generated by burning debris drift through the depot, creating shifting blind spots and obscuring vision.

entities.name: Glimpses of torn body parts are revealed in smoke openings
entities.description: As the smoke shifts, brief views of dismembered human remains become visible, indicating a violent and deadly attack.

entities.name: Riley identifies stenches as the perpetrators
entities.description: Riley concludes that the stenches (zombies) have attacked the depot, based on the nature and extent of the destruction.

entities.name: Riley leads the team into the smoke-filled depot
entities.description: Riley moves forward into the hazardous environment with his M-16 ready, guiding his team through the dangerous, obscured terrain.

entities.name: Team members speak in hushed tones due to tension
entities.description: The team communicates quietly, reflecting their nervousness and the threatening atmosphere of the damaged depot.

entities.name: Manolete suggests the truck caused the fence breach
entities.description: Manolete hypothesizes that the departing truck knocked down the fence, allowing intruders to enter the depot.

entities.name: Riley corrects Manolete about the direction of the fence breach
entities.description: Riley points out that the fencing was pushed inward from the outside, indicating an external attack rather than an accident.

entities.name: Teahouse questions the number of stenches required for the breach
entities.description: Teahouse expresses disbelief at the scale of force needed to push in the fence, highlighting the threat level.

entities.name: Riley warns of overwhelming zombie numbers
entities.description: Riley emphasizes the dire imbalance in numbers, stating there are a thousand stenches for every human survivor.

entities.name: Charlie asserts human superiority in intelligence
entities.description: Charlie counters Riley's grim assessment by noting that humans are smarter than the zombies, offering a sliver of hope.

entities.name: Slack mocks Charlie's confidence
entities.description: Slack responds sarcastically to Charlie's claim of human intelligence, undermining the optimism in the group.

entities.name: Riley reveals zombies are becoming smarter
entities.description: Riley shares his observation from Uniontown that zombies are learning to cooperate, indicating evolving threat behavior.

entities.name: Smoke thickens and impairs team's vision
entities.description: The smoke in the depot grows denser, reducing visibility to near zero and increasing the sense of danger and disorientation.

entities.name: Ambient sounds heighten tension in the depot
entities.description: The environment is filled with unsettling noises—wind moaning, metal and wood cracking—amplifying the team's anxiety.

entities.name: Teahouse questions the zombies' motives
entities.description: Teahouse asks what the zombies want, prompting speculation about their intentions and strategic behavior.

entities.name: Slack observes zombies breaching another section of fence
entities.description: As she looks back, Slack sees the zombies tearing down an additional part of the depot's perimeter fence.

entities.name: Slack deduces zombies are targeting the city
entities.description: Slack concludes that the zombies' objective is to reach the city, based on the direction of their advance and the visible high-rise beyond the river.

entities.name: Riley confirms zombies are targeting the human survivors
entities.description: Riley interprets the attack as personal, stating the zombies are after the survivors because of past confrontations.

entities.name: Manolete expresses confidence in the river as a barrier
entities.description: Manolete believes the river will prevent the zombies from reaching the city, offering a sense of security.

entities.name: Charlie expresses religious gratitude
entities.description: Charlie thanks Heaven for the protection offered by the river, revealing his continued faith despite the apocalypse.

entities.name: Riley mocks Charlie's belief in Heaven
entities.description: Riley comments sarcastically on Charlie's faith, showing skepticism toward religious beliefs in the current world.

entities.name: Riley requests a radio from the team
entities.description: Riley asks if anyone has a radio, likely intending to communicate or gather information about the situation.

entities.name: Teahouse produces and attempts to toss a Motorola radio to Riley
entities.description: Teahouse retrieves a Motorola radio from his belt and throws it toward Riley to fulfill his request.

entities.name: Growling sound interrupts the team's movement
entities.description: Just as the radio is being passed, a sudden growling noise is heard, signaling the presence of nearby zombies and imminent danger.

entities.description: Slack whispers a question to Charlie, asking why he wets the rifle sight.

entities.description: Charlie whispers back to Slack, explaining that wetting the sight helps catch the moonlight and improves aiming accuracy.

entities.name: Zombie emerges from smoke and attacks Slack
entities.description: A dead man steps out of the smoke and grabs Slack from behind before she pulls away.

entities.name: Slack hesitates to shoot zombie due to entry wound
entities.description: Slack prepares to shoot the zombie but stops upon seeing an entry wound on its forehead, indicating it was already hit.

entities.description: Charlie confirms he hit the zombie, noting the shot was off-center but still effective.

entities.description: The zombie releases its grip and falls dead at Slack's feet after Charlie's bullet takes effect.

document_metadata.title: 137、INT. FIDDLER'S GREEN ATRIUM - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Kaufman shoots Big Daddy, who remains focused on him despite the injury; out of ammo, Kaufman is pulled by Knipp into a stairway as Big Daddy, unlike other Walkers, continues toward them with rage.

entities.name: Kaufman and Knipp exit elevator with security guards carrying duffles
entities.description: Kaufman and Knipp, carrying Prada duffles and accompanied by four security guards, rush out of an elevator onto the street level of the atrium.

entities.name: Residents panic and flee in all directions
entities.description: As chaos erupts in the atrium, residents scream and run wildly in all directions, overwhelmed by the unfolding crisis.

entities.name: Walkers assault glass doors leading to the street
entities.description: A group of ten Walkers violently attack the bank of glass doors at the atrium's entrance, attempting to break through to the interior.

entities.name: Kaufman orders retreat to the car downstairs
entities.description: Kaufman shouts commands to retreat downstairs to the car, recognizing the immediate threat at the glass doors.

entities.name: One security guard flees from the group
entities.description: Amid rising tension, one of the four security guards abandons the group and runs away in fear.

entities.name: Kaufman fires three rounds at fleeing guards
entities.description: Kaufman shoots three times at the fleeing security guards in an attempt to stop them, wounding one.

entities.name: Wounded guard turns weapon on Kaufman
entities.description: The security guard who was shot whirls around and points his M-16 rifle at Kaufman, preparing to retaliate.

entities.name: Knipp intervenes to prevent guard from shooting Kaufman
entities.description: Knipp steps in front of Kaufman and grabs his gun hand, pleading with both the guard and Kaufman to stop the violence and reminding them they should be on the same side.

entities.name: Security guard declares independence and flees
entities.description: The armed guard rejects unity, declares he is on his own side, and runs off to join the others who have fled.

entities.name: Cholo confronts Kaufman in the atrium
entities.description: Cholo approaches Kaufman across the atrium, revealing he has been bitten and intends to ensure Kaufman suffers the same fate.

entities.name: Walkers intensify attack on glass doors with tools
entities.description: The Walkers escalate their assault on the glass doors by using shovels, pickaxes, and pipes, creating loud metallic clangs with each strike.

entities.name: atrium
entities.description: A three-story interior space where residents flee and characters confront the walker assault on glass doors.

entities.name: street level
entities.description: The ground floor of the atrium where characters emerge and attempt to reach the car.

entities.name: elevator
entities.description: The elevator from which Kaufman, Knipp, and security guards exit at the beginning of the scene.

entities.name: glass doors

entities.name: car
entities.description: A vehicle located downstairs that Kaufman intends to reach for escape.

entities.name: Paul Kaufman
entities.description: A man carrying a gun who is attempting to lead a group to safety during a walker attack, showing authority and desperation.
entities.summary: An authoritative figure oversees crisis response, refusing to negotiate with Cholo, managing security threats, and coordinating with team members while maintaining control and prioritizing certain individuals amid high-stakes decisions.

entities.name: Tyler Knipp
entities.description: A loyal associate of Kaufman who intervenes to prevent a wounded security guard from shooting Kaufman.
entities.summary: An associate of Kaufman assists him amid a deteriorating situation, helps him after a shooting, confirms helicopter departure, and aids his escape until confronted by Big Daddy while refueling a limousine.

entities.name: Cholo Denbo
entities.description: A man who has been bitten by walkers and confronts Kaufman with a desire for revenge, declaring his intent to see Kaufman suffer the same fate.
entities.summary: A group arrives in a town via moving van and motorcycle, discovering a disturbing scene under a crate; a guerrilla leader questions them, while members explore, including a stop at a liquor store, and tensions rise among the group.

entities.description: One of four guards accompanying Kaufman and Knipp who becomes wounded and turns on Kaufman before fleeing.

entities.name: Big Daddy uses pneumatic hammer to attack safety glass doors
entities.description: Big Daddy strikes the safety glass doors with a pneumatic hammer, initiating a forceful assault on the building's entrance.

entities.name: Kaufman attempts to flee through stairway door
entities.description: Overwhelmed by the escalating violence, Kaufman abruptly runs toward a stairway door in an attempt to escape.

entities.name: Cholo shoots arrow into Kaufman's calf
entities.description: Cholo fires an arrow that strikes Kaufman in the back of his left calf, causing him to collapse.

entities.name: Kaufman drops money bag and gun after being shot
entities.description: As a result of being hit by an arrow, Kaufman falls and releases both his bag of money and his firearm, which slides away from him.

entities.name: Knipp rushes to assist wounded Kaufman
entities.description: Knipp moves quickly to help Kaufman after he is shot and falls to the ground.

entities.name: Knipp pleads with Cholo to allow their escape
entities.description: Knipp appeals to Cholo, asking him to let them leave the building safely.

entities.name: Cholo allows Knipp to leave but not Kaufman
entities.description: Cholo informs Knipp that he is free to go, but explicitly states that Kaufman must remain.

entities.name: Kaufman crawls toward his gun despite injuries
entities.description: Refusing to surrender, Kaufman drags himself on hands and knees toward his dropped weapon, enduring severe pain.

entities.name: Big Daddy's hammer chisel penetrates glass doors
entities.description: The chisel attachment on Big Daddy's pneumatic hammer breaks through the safety glass, creating the first physical breach in the doors.

entities.name: Glass doors cobweb but do not shatter
entities.description: The safety glass fractures into a web of tiny crystals held together by a plastic layer, preventing full collapse.

entities.name: Alarm bells sound after door breach
entities.description: Following the partial destruction of the glass doors, alarm systems activate throughout the building.

entities.name: Big Daddy touches and probes the damaged glass
entities.description: Curious and confused by the altered state of the glass, Big Daddy drops his tool and reaches out to touch it.

entities.name: Big Daddy pokes his hand through the breached glass
entities.description: Big Daddy physically inserts his hand through the compromised section of the glass door, gaining access to the interior.

entities.name: Cholo shoots second arrow into Kaufman's shoulder
entities.description: As Kaufman continues to crawl toward his gun, Cholo fires another arrow, striking him in the shoulder.

entities.name: Kaufman curses Cholo after being shot in the shoulder
entities.description: In pain and rage, Kaufman shouts a racial slur and curse at Cholo after being hit by the second arrow.

entities.name: Cholo responds calmly, suggesting conversation later
entities.description: Cholo, remaining composed, tells Kaufman they can talk once he has calmed down.

entities.name: Multiple tools penetrate glass doors in rapid succession
entities.description: Additional attackers use their tools to break through the weakened glass doors, creating multiple entry points.

entities.name: Hands of Walkers poke through breached doors
entities.description: Following the structural failure of the glass, the hands of Walkers begin to push through the cobwebbed surface.

entities.name: Walkers begin to invade atrium through compromised doors
entities.description: The Walkers start forcing their way into the building's atrium through the damaged glass doors, marking the beginning of their full-scale invasion.

entities.name: Big Daddy
entities.description: A Walker who leads the assault on the safety glass doors using a pneumatic hammer and is the first to breach the atrium by poking his hand through the damaged glass.
entities.summary: A former Texaco attendant, now a reanimated undead missing an arm, leads zombies in attacks, intervenes violently to protect a family, kills Barrett, and disarms others at the depot.

entities.name: Knipp helps wounded Kaufman across underground parking garage
entities.description: Knipp, carrying a Prada duffle, supports the injured Kaufman as they move together through a dark and eerie underground parking garage filled with distant screams.

entities.description: Knipp turns the key to start the limousine's engine, the sound echoing loudly throughout the concrete structure of the underground parking garage.

entities.description: Knipp observes the fuel gauge on the dashboard and comments that the vehicle needs gas, indicating their need to refuel before leaving the garage.

entities.name: Knipp prepares to refuel limousine but is interrupted
entities.description: After activating the pump, Knipp pulls the nozzle to begin refueling but freezes upon hearing echoing footsteps approaching through the shadows.

entities.name: Knipp reacts to sudden appearance of dark figure
entities.description: Startled by the sight of a dark figure approaching, Knipp drops the fuel nozzle, quickly ducks into the limousine, and slams the door shut for safety.

entities.name: Big Daddy confronts Knipp and Kaufman at gas pump
entities.description: A furious Big Daddy appears outside the limousine, slamming his hand against the driver's window and then moving to peer through the windshield, recognizing Kaufman as the man who shot him.
